about.whatText: Aloca is a one-of-a-kind travel app that makes planning a trip as easy as playing a game, so you can estimate how much your trip will cost. You can chat with artificial intelligence and get smart suggestions with better-optimized itineraries. Aloca makes travelling unique and convenient.
about.highlightGame: Planning as easy as a game
about.benefitSubtitle: How Aloca helps you on every trip.
about.benefit1Text: Aloca gives you the tools to plan your trip conveniently: from finding a destination to setting the dates and the budget.
about.benefit2Text: Tailor your itinerary to your own interests and needs.
about.benefit3Text: Aloca provides detailed information about destinations, including sights, restaurants, entertainment and more, so you get an overview of where you are going and can pick the activities that suit you.

location.title: Let Aloca see your location
location.explain: To confirm you are at the challenge place (within 250 m), Aloca needs your current location. It is only used to check the distance and is not stored. Your browser will ask next: choose "Allow".
location.checkingText: This can take a few seconds, especially indoors.
location.deniedText: Your browser blocks location for this site, so the challenge cannot be confirmed. Turn it back on:
location.unavailableText: Turn on Location/GPS on your device, turn on Wi‑Fi or move to an open area for a better fix, then try again.
location.timeoutText: Your device did not return a position. Check that GPS is on and try again.
location.insecureText: Browsers only share location with https:// pages or localhost. Open Aloca with an https address (not http://IP-address).
location.unsupportedText: Open Aloca in a recent Chrome, Safari, Edge or Firefox.
location.nearText: You are about {{distance}} from the place. Take a photo to complete the challenge.
location.farText: You are about {{distance}} away. Get within {{max}} m and check again.
location.lowAccuracy: Your location is only accurate to about ±{{accuracy}} m. Turn on GPS or Wi‑Fi for a better fix.
location.mapDenied: Re-allow location for this site with the steps below to see where you are on the map.
location.mapAskText: Press the location button again and choose "Allow" when your browser asks.
stepsDesktop: Click the icon just left of the page address (two sliders, a lock or ⓘ).
Turn on Location. Not there? Choose Site settings → Location → Allow.
Still blocked? Turn on your computer's location: Windows → Settings → Privacy & security → Location.
Come back here and press Try again.
stepsAndroid: Turn on Location (GPS): pull down the notification shade and tap Location.
In Chrome: tap ⋮ → Settings → Site settings → Location and allow this site.
Come back here and press Try again.
stepsIos: Open Settings → Privacy & Security → Location Services: turn it on and set Safari (or your browser) to "While Using the App".
In Safari: tap aA in the address bar → Website Settings → Location → Allow.
Come back here and press Try again.
stepsSafari: In the menu bar: Safari → Settings → Websites → Location, and allow this site.
Turn on Location Services for Safari in System Settings → Privacy & Security.
Come back here and press Try again.
stepsFirefox: Click the lock icon on the left of the address bar.
Click ✕ next to "Access your location: Blocked" to clear it.
Press Try again and choose Allow when Firefox asks.
